title: Open-weight model tops Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index by H1 2027
body: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight Mixture-of-Experts model, debuted on July 16 already ranked fourth of 189 systems on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at roughly 57 — level with Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 — and took outright first place on the Frontend Code Arena ahead of the leading closed models. That puts the best open-weight system within a couple of points of the very top of a major aggregate capability index for the first time, rather than trailing the closed frontier by a clear margin. With Moonshot committing to publish Kimi K3's full weights by July 27, and a cluster of Chinese labs alongside the GLM and Qwen lineages shipping frontier-adjacent open releases while routing around US compute-export limits, the open-weight cohort now has both the trajectory and the release cadence to close the last gap. The prediction is that by H1 2027 an open-weight model holds the outright top rank on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — a sustained number-one, not a single-day blip — ending the closed-model monopoly at the very top of a widely cited leaderboard. The most likely trigger is the July 27 weights drop followed by a successor open release, whether a Kimi K3.x refresh or a rival Chinese lab's answer, that clears the remaining few points.

reasoning.so_that: an open-weight model takes and holds the outright top rank on a major aggregate capability index, not a one-day blip
reasoning.landing: by H1 2027; open-weight #1 on Artificial Analysis Index after K3 weights drop
reasoning.plain_language: Free-to-download AI models are now almost as smart as the best paid ones. Within a year, one will likely rank as the single best model.

summary: Kimi K3 debuted fourth on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, level with Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5, and topped the Frontend Code Arena — the closest open weights have come to the top. With full weights due July 27 and a Chinese open-weight cohort behind it, one likely takes #1 by H1 2027.
